problem_solution.title: Closing the Medical & Educational Engagement Gap
problem_points: Traditional rehabilitation has high attrition due to repetitive, non-immersive exercises.
Static clinical training fails to simulate complex multi-sensory surgical and emergency scenarios.
Lack of real-time objective bio-spatial analytics in patient recovery protocols.
solution_points: Spatial Therapeutics: Immersive XR environments trigger neuro-plasticity and boost pain tolerance.
Interactive Spatial Canvas: Multi-user real-time surgical and clinical simulations.
Data-Driven Bio-Feedback: Eye-tracking, motor accuracy, and cognitive stress metrics mapped in 3D.

features.title: Spatial Therapeutics

features.title: WebXR & Standalone Compatibility
features.desc: Deploy seamlessly across Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest 3, HTC Vive, and standard Web browsers without app friction.

features.title: Interactive Learning
features.desc: Hands-on multi-user spatial simulations for surgical training, medical residency, and institutional education.

features.title: Data-Driven Insights

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all components are strictly created/edited in .js / .jsx formats (not .tsx).
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, links, modals) include explicit data-testid attributes as mapped above.
Implement high-impact dark mode glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl, subtle cyan/violet borders, and ambient neon glows.
Avoid default pure black (#000000); use tinted deep space color (#050714 or #0a0d24) as recommended by E1 rules.
Ensure toast notifications use sonner package.
Use Lucide React or Phosphor icons for futuristic UI iconography.
